svg.text: VITIS VINIFERA CV. DORONA — ANATOMY OF A LAGOON-ADAPTED GRAPE

g.text: Na⁺ / Cl⁻ blocked at root tips
Na⁺ / Cl⁻ sequestered in vacuoles & older leaves
Compatible solutes maintain cell turgor under salt stress
stress perception → ABA signalling → osmolyte synthesis → turgor recovery
Lagoon microclimate: thermal buffering · elevated humidity · salt-laden winds ·
reflected light from water surface · 150+ day growing season · DOC Venezia
Planting density: 3,500–5,000 vines/ha · Training: Guyot simple · Elevation: 0–3 m asl
